perks.name: Adrenal Rush
perks.description: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
perks.exact:
Upon sprinting for 0.5 seconds:
Grants Adrenal Rush for 5 seconds.
Scoring a kill or retriggering the perk refreshes the buff duration.

Adrenal Rush | +40 Handling, +30 Reload Speed, and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

perks.name: Bountiful Munitions
perks.description: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.
perks.exact:
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

Elite+ Combatants Kills grant +16% Special Ammo Progress.
Elite+ Taken Combatant Kills grant +24% Special Ammo Progress.
Guardian Kills grant +?% Special Ammo Progress.
Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs, granting +16% Special Ammo Progress.
